newsitem.title: UK: Aer Rianta chief executive to retire at end-1997.
newsitem.headline: Aer Rianta chief executive to retire at end-1997.

text.p: State-owned Irish airports operator, Aer Rianta chief executive Derek Keogh plans to retire at the end of 1997, Aer Rianta said in a statement.
Derek Keogh has been chief executive since 1988 and has been with Aer Rianta for 28 years.
It added that he had told the organisation's board of the decision now "so that they will have ample opportunity to make arrangements" for a successor.
Aer Rianta chairman Noel Hanlon, said the board had accepted Keogh's decision 'with regret' -Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 -www.racs.com
